0.text: Build a website for under $500 and start getting found.

1.text: A small business website costs between $500 and $8, 000 to build in 2025
plus $150 to $500 per month to keep running.
Where you land depends on one choice: template or custom.

2.text: The template-build tier costs $500 to $2,000 one time.
A freelancer or small agency takes a pre-made theme, swaps in your branding, writes a few pages
Fast and cheap, with limited custom work.
The custom tier costs $3,000 to $8,000 one time .

3.text: Most owners can launch a clean five-page site in a weekend.
Hire a pro if your time is worth more than the savings, if you need custom features
or if a sloppy site would cost you customers.

4.text: Words and photos cost money if you do not supply them.
Professional copywriting runs $100 to $400 per page.
Keyword research and local search optimization usually cost extra.
When you get a quote, ask the builder to itemize these five.
A vague flat number hides where your money goes and makes it hard to compare bids.

5.text: Budget $150 to $300 a year for domain plus hosting on a self-hosted setup.
A website is not a one-time purchase.
Ongoing upkeep for a professionally built small business site, covering the domain, hosting
and routine updates, averages $150 to $500 per month .

6.text: The second option is why so many small businesses stay on Squarespace or Wix even when a custom site would look better.
Before you sign any build contract, ask one question: what does month two cost?
If the builder cannot answer, you are about to be surprised.

7.text: Pay $16 to $40 a month, do the work yourself, and launch in a weekend.
Pay for a template build at $1,000 to $2,000.
You get a professional look without custom-build prices, and you can launch in two to three weeks.
Invest in a custom build at $3,000 to $8,000.

8.text: That total is your real first-year cost, and it is the only figure worth comparing across quotes.
Once you see it written down, the right tier for your business gets obvious
and you can stop guessing and start getting found.
